findings.title: Dataset video quality improved significantly
findings.statement: The overall video data quality score increased from 61.6 out of 100 to 97.8 out of 100 after cleaning operations.
findings.recommendation: Use the cleaned dataset for training to ensure higher model performance.

findings.title: Dataset size reduced after cleaning
findings.statement: Cleaning operations removed 7 videos, reducing the total video count from 30 down to 23.
findings.recommendation: Verify that the final set of 23 videos meets all minimum requirements for your training pipeline.

findings.title: Presence of duplicate files in raw data
findings.statement: The raw dataset contained 1 group of byte-identical files and 3 groups of near-extra copies.
findings.recommendation: Ensure duplicate removal steps are consistently applied to prevent data leakage during training.

findings.title: Identified quality issues in raw video files
findings.statement: Raw quality checks identified 1 corrupt video, 1 too_short video, 1 black video, and 1 frozen video.
findings.recommendation: Filter out corrupted, short, black, and frozen video samples before ingestion into the classifier.

findings.title: Suspected mislabeled videos found
findings.statement: Vision review flagged a total of 3 suspected mislabeled videos across the dataset categories that require manual inspection before removal.
findings.recommendation: Manually inspect the flagged videos to correct their labels or remove them from the training set.

findings.title: Class distribution and imbalance
findings.statement: The cleaned dataset contains 23 videos across 3 classes with an imbalance ratio of 1.5.
findings.recommendation: Apply class weighting or data augmentation to account for class imbalance during training.

findings.title: Silent audio track present
findings.statement: There is 1 silent audio track detected in the dataset.
findings.recommendation: Check if audio features are required for your model; if so, inspect or replace the silent track.

narrative.headline: Dataset quality for pattern_clips.zip successfully improved from 61.6 to 97.8 out of 100 after cleaning 30 videos down to 23.
narrative.executive_summary: Cleaning operations successfully boosted the video quality score from 61.6 out of 100 to 97.8 out of 100 by removing 7 problematic videos, leaving 23 total videos across 3 classes. The raw data contained byte-identical files, near-extra copies, a corrupt video, a too_short video, a black video, and a frozen video. Additionally, vision review flagged 3 suspected mislabeled videos requiring manual inspection, and 1 silent audio track was detected. The cleaned dataset maintains an imbalance ratio of 1.5.
next_steps: Manually inspect the 3 suspected mislabeled videos flagged during vision review before final model training.
Verify the single silent audio track to determine if it impacts the video classifier requirements.
Proceed with training the video classifier using the 23 cleaned videos across 3 classes.
